title: Block C++: Noughts and Crosses
description: An inclusive, Lego-style block course that teaches C++ one line at a time by building a playable Noughts and Crosses (Tic-Tac-Toe) game. Learners snap shaped blocks together, type names and values that are checked live, then run their own code in a built-in terminal and export real C++.
subject: Computer Science
audience: Learners new to text-based programming, including learners with dyslexia and learning difficulties
learningOutcomes: Use #include and namespaces to set up a C++ program
Declare variables and 2D arrays with suitable data types
Write and call void and value-returning functions
Use for loops, nested for loops and while loops
Make decisions with if, else and else if
Read input with cin and print output with cout
Group data with a struct and model objects with classes and inheritance
Run, test and export a complete C++ program
features: Free-form canvas with snapping, shape-checked blocks
Line-by-line guide with live checklists for every step
Live validation of names, values and code order with plain-English errors
Run Code Live terminal that runs the learner's own blocks
C++ code view with copy and download
Undo, keyboard controls and tap-to-place for touch screens
